result.topic_en: Methodological remarks on synthetic versus analytic procedures in the theory of the finer sense organs, and on how analogy and teleology may be used without arbitrariness.

methods.what: Methodological principle: synthesis and analysis are mutually dependent (synthesis rests on prior analysis; analysis is confirmed or corrected by subsequent synthesis)

items.english: The first, predominantly synthetic procedure is to be rejected for the theory of the finer sense organs, because the preconditions for the applicability of the procedure are too incompletely fulfilled, while supplementing these preconditions by analogy and teleology remains entirely arbitrary here.

items.english: In the second, predominantly analytic procedure, the help of teleology and analogy cannot be entirely dispensed with either, but arbitrariness can be avoided in their use.
